metadata.title: Twisted pencils of quartics, braid monodromy factorizations, and non-Hopfian Hurwitz curves
metadata.abstract: We study which groups arise as fundamental groups of complements of affine Hurwitz curves. In every such group the product of the meridians is central and maps to the vector of component degrees in homology; this rules out, for instance, the Baumslag-Solitar groups $\operatorname{BS}(p,q)$ with $\lvert p\rvert\neq\lvert q\rvert$, and the groups of links with at least two components and vanishing linking numbers. O. V. Kulikova circumvented this obstruction for $\operatorname{BS}(2,3)$ by passing to the non-Hopfian group $\operatorname{BS}(2,3)\times\mathbb{Z}$, which Vik. S. Kulikov's doubling algorithm realizes in degree $768$. We give an explicit braid monodromy factorization of degree 12 with this group. The corresponding curve is not isotopic to an algebraic curve, yet it is obtained from a union of three quartics in a pencil by a single twist along a circle. More generally, for every closed braid $\hat\beta$ we realize $\pi_1(S^3\setminus\hat\beta)\times\mathbb{Z}$ by an explicit Hurwitz curve, again a twist of a union of quartics in a pencil. In the other direction, a Hurwitz curve with group $\operatorname{BS}(k,k+1)\times\mathbb{Z}$ has degree at least $4$, as every Hurwitz curve consisting of a conic and a line is H-isotopic to an algebraic one, after separation of its critical points. Finally, we show that certain semiholomorphic germs, among them those realizing the generalized Borromean rings, are braided surfaces but not Hurwitz curve germs.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 低次数显式实现与障碍
analysis.workSummary: 给出群BS(2,3)×Z的12次Hurwitz曲线显式辫单值分解，大幅降低既有768次实现。曲线由铅笔中的三条四次曲线经一次圆周扭转得到，且不与代数曲线同痕。更一般地，对任意闭辫实现其补空间群与Z的直积，并给出相关低次数障碍及半全纯曲面芽的反例。
analysis.breakthrough: 通过具体低次数构造实现非Hopfian群，并推广到闭辫补空间群。
analysis.limitations: BS(p,q)本身受经线乘积中心性约束；实现的是加Z后的群，次数下界等结论有特定曲线类条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
